_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Burning Bonds#000.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 與 Abramod 交談。

Burning Bonds#001.src: Halt, stranger! If you value your life, do not take another step forward.
Burning Bonds#001.dst: 站住，陌生人！若你還惜命，就別再往前一步。
Burning Bonds#001.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#002.src: I have nothing left to give you! Leave, you and your kindred!
Burning Bonds#002.dst: 我已經沒有任何東西能給你了！走吧，你和你的同類都走！
Burning Bonds#002.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#003.src: You're completely unscathed? You must be powerful indeed, no changeling could defeat you.
Burning Bonds#003.dst: 你竟毫髮無傷？看來你確實強大，換形者不可能打得贏你。
Burning Bonds#003.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#004.src: Still though, I have nothing for you. I even lack a medallion to prove my own identity...
Burning Bonds#004.dst: 不過話說回來，我這裡沒有你要的東西。我連一枚能證明自己身分的徽牌都沒有……
Burning Bonds#004.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#005.src: Ah, you have lost yours too? Kindred spirits we are, dead to our worlds!
Burning Bonds#005.dst: 啊，你的也弄丟了？我們真是同病相憐之人，對各自的世界而言都已是死者！
Burning Bonds#005.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#006.src: Lost to my clan, dead to my family, assumed to be a brute beast of the worst sort... I am sure you can understand, being in the same state as myself?
Burning Bonds#006.dst: 與氏族失散，在家人眼中已死，被當成最下等的野獸……你和我處境相同，想必能夠明白？
Burning Bonds#006.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#007.src: It is some small comfort to find one in the same situation as myself. I will not pry into you, I know the value of secrets as well as anyone. But please, will you allow me a measure of catharsis and lend me an empathetic ear so I may tell my tale?
Burning Bonds#007.dst: 能遇見一個與我境遇相同的人，多少是點安慰。我不會探問你的事，祕密的分量我和誰都一樣清楚。但可否請你讓我稍作宣洩，借我一雙願意傾聽的耳朵，聽我說完我的故事？
Burning Bonds#007.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#008.src: You have returned! Now, are you willing to take a moment to listen to my tale?
Burning Bonds#008.dst: 你回來了！那麼，你願意撥點時間聽我說說我的故事嗎？
Burning Bonds#008.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#009.src: The forest here is safe, I ought to return home.
Burning Bonds#009.dst: 這裡的森林安全了，我也該回家了。
Burning Bonds#009.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#011.src: Abramod... I want to come home now.
Burning Bonds#011.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#012.src: If you give me your medallion, I can be with you again.
Burning Bonds#012.dst: 只要你把徽牌給我，我就能再和你在一起。
Burning Bonds#012.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#013.src: If you can't show me your medallion, how could I know you are really you?
Burning Bonds#013.dst: 你若拿不出你的徽牌，我又怎能確定你真的是你？
Burning Bonds#013.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#014.src: There are creatures that take the shape of any man, and they want to kill us! It would be ignorant to not take it with you!
Burning Bonds#014.dst: 有些生物能變成任何人的模樣，而牠們想殺了我們！不把徽牌帶在身上，那才是無知！
Burning Bonds#014.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#015.src: Give me your medallion. I can become one of you.
Burning Bonds#015.dst: 把你的徽牌給我。我就能成為你們之中的一員。
Burning Bonds#015.speaker: Lishvil

Burning Bonds#016.src: You are not Lishvil. And judging by that, he disposed of his before you could get to it.
Burning Bonds#016.dst: 你不是 Lishvil。從這句話看來，他在你下手之前就把自己的處理掉了。
Burning Bonds#016.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#017.src: If it means you won't deceive my clan, I'll burn my medallion, like Lishvil did! You can kill me, but you will never be me!
Burning Bonds#017.dst: 只要能讓你騙不了我的氏族，我就把我的徽牌燒了，就像 Lishvil 那樣！你可以殺了我，但你永遠成不了我！
Burning Bonds#017.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#019.src: Hyup! There, if you want it so bad, go get it!
Burning Bonds#019.dst: 嘿！喏，你這麼想要，就自己去拿吧！
Burning Bonds#019.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#021.src: That is my story. It is unfortunate it cannot have a happier ending, unless...
Burning Bonds#021.dst: 這就是我的故事。可惜它沒有辦法有個好一點的結局，除非……
Burning Bonds#021.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#022.src: I do know how to make a new medallion, but it is a difficult task. Collecting the materials required for it would be more dangerous for my frail body than fending for myself out here...
Burning Bonds#022.dst: 我確實知道怎麼做出一枚新的徽牌，只是那並不容易。以我這副虛弱的身子，去蒐集所需的材料，恐怕比在這荒野裡自求生路還要危險……
Burning Bonds#022.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#023.src: With you however, we might be able to gather them. If you prove yourself trustworthy, I could even help you make one as well. How does that sound?
Burning Bonds#023.dst: 但若有你在，我們或許就辦得到。而只要你證明自己值得信任，我甚至可以順便幫你也做一枚。你覺得如何？
Burning Bonds#023.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#025.src: First, we will need a wooden base for the medallion.
Burning Bonds#025.dst: 首先，我們需要一塊木頭做徽牌的底座。
Burning Bonds#025.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#026.src: There's an old, lightning struck tree to the south that we traditionally go to.
Burning Bonds#026.dst: 南邊有一棵被雷劈過的老樹，我們一向都是去那裡取材。
Burning Bonds#026.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#027.src: I will write the directions to it for you and meet you by it.
Burning Bonds#027.dst: 我把路線寫給你，我們在那棵樹旁邊會合。
Burning Bonds#027.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#028.src: Meet Abramod near the lightning struck tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Burning Bonds#028.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 被雷劈過的樹旁與 Abramod 會合。

Burning Bonds#029.src: This tree was struck by lightning many generations ago. And yet it has remained standing, even after death.
Burning Bonds#029.dst: 這棵樹是好幾代以前被雷劈中的。然而即使死了，它依然站著。
Burning Bonds#029.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#030.src: The bark from it has proven sturdy enough that it works well as a medallion's base.
Burning Bonds#030.dst: 事實證明它的樹皮夠堅韌，很適合拿來做徽牌的底座。
Burning Bonds#030.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#031.src: However it might be a bit, ah, difficult to reach. It is in part why I need your help.
Burning Bonds#031.dst: 不過要取到它可能，呃，有點困難。這也是我需要你幫忙的原因之一。
Burning Bonds#031.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#032.src: I will... assist you in climbing the tree. On your way down, you will need to hit {~} of the healthier branches so we have enough bark.
Burning Bonds#032.dst: 我會……協助你爬上樹。下來的路上，你得打下 {~} 根比較健康的樹枝，我們才有足夠的樹皮。
Burning Bonds#032.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#033.src: I'll need to stay down here so I can collect the bark as it hits the ground.
Burning Bonds#033.dst: 我得留在下面，樹皮落地的時候好收起來。
Burning Bonds#033.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#036.src: If you need time to get your bearings, I understand. Come back when you're ready!
Burning Bonds#036.dst: 如果你需要時間定一定神，我明白。準備好了再回來找我！
Burning Bonds#036.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#037.src: Looks like you didn't quite hit enough branches...
Burning Bonds#037.dst: 看來你打下來的樹枝不太夠……
Burning Bonds#037.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#039.src: Remember, you need to hit {~} healthy branches.
Burning Bonds#039.dst: 記住，你得打下 {~} 根健康的樹枝。
Burning Bonds#039.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#041.src: I understand. Talk to me again when you've caught your breath.
Burning Bonds#041.dst: 我明白。等你喘過氣來再跟我說。
Burning Bonds#041.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#042.src: Good! This should be enough for the bases.
Burning Bonds#042.dst: 很好！這些做底座應該夠了。
Burning Bonds#042.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#043.src: Next we'll need to collect some resin to lacquer the medallion with.
Burning Bonds#043.dst: 接下來我們得蒐集一些樹脂，用來替徽牌上漆。
Burning Bonds#043.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#044.src: High in a mountain meadow to the east, a fern grows that excretes a resin that works well for the task.
Burning Bonds#044.dst: 東邊高山上的草地裡長著一種蕨類，它分泌的樹脂很適合這個用途。
Burning Bonds#044.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#045.src: I'll write you some instructions on how to get there and see you once you arrive.
Burning Bonds#045.dst: 我把去那裡的路線寫給你，你到了我們再碰面。
Burning Bonds#045.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#046.src: Meet Abramod in the mountain grove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Burning Bonds#046.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的山中林地與 Abramod 會合。

Burning Bonds#047.src: This meadow is home to a rare fern that we collect resin from to make our medallions.
Burning Bonds#047.dst: 這片草地上長著一種稀有的蕨類，我們就是從它身上採樹脂來做徽牌的。
Burning Bonds#047.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#048.src: Do not go searching for it just yet though! It is also home to a poisonous fern that appears very similar to the one we need.
Burning Bonds#048.dst: 不過先別急著去找！這裡同時也長著一種有毒的蕨類，外表和我們要的那種非常相似。
Burning Bonds#048.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#049.src: My eyes aren't so good anymore, so I'm going to need your help to tell them apart!
Burning Bonds#049.dst: 我的眼睛已經不太好了，所以得靠你來幫我分辨！
Burning Bonds#049.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#050.src: I'm going to toss the plants for you. You can pick them up by right-clicking them - even while they're still in the air!
Burning Bonds#050.dst: 我會把植物拋給你。你可以用右鍵撿起它們——就算還在半空中也可以！
Burning Bonds#050.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#051.src: Place the greener, healthier looking plants to the side where I am now. And you'll need to burn the poisonous, more sickly looking plants on the other side.
Burning Bonds#051.dst: 把比較綠、看起來比較健康的那些放到我現在這一側。有毒、看起來比較病懨懨的那些，你得在另一側燒掉。
Burning Bonds#051.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#052.src: We'll need {~} of the good ferns to extract enough resin. But make sure the poisonous ferns don't build up too much or it could be dangerous for you!
Burning Bonds#052.dst: 我們需要 {~} 株好的蕨類才能萃取出足夠的樹脂。但千萬別讓有毒的那些堆積太多，那對你來說會很危險！
Burning Bonds#052.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#053.src: You'll only be able to pick up one at a time, so good luck!
Burning Bonds#053.dst: 你一次只能撿一株，祝你好運！
Burning Bonds#053.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#056.src: I understand. I'll be here whenever you are.
Burning Bonds#056.dst: 我明白。你什麼時候好了，我都在這裡。
Burning Bonds#056.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#057.src: Looks like you didn't get enough!
Burning Bonds#057.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#062.src: There's only one final thing we need: knives to cut the bark with.
Burning Bonds#062.dst: 我們只剩最後一樣東西：用來切割樹皮的刀。
Burning Bonds#062.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#063.src: Put that away, we don't need just any knife!
Burning Bonds#063.dst: 把那個收起來，我們要的可不是隨便一把刀！
Burning Bonds#063.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#064.src: Tradition dictates we have to descend to a cave beneath this mountain where much of the fog of the {p} settles. Deep inside are stones we've used for generations in carving our medallions.
Burning Bonds#064.dst: 照傳統，我們必須下到這座山底下的一個洞穴，{p}的霧氣大多沉積在那裡。洞穴深處有我們世代用來雕刻徽牌的石頭。
Burning Bonds#064.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#065.src: I'll write down the directions for you again and meet you there.
Burning Bonds#065.dst: 我再把路線寫下來給你，我們在那裡碰面。
Burning Bonds#065.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#066.src: Meet Abramod outside of the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Burning Bonds#066.dst: 到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的洞穴外與 Abramod 會合。

Burning Bonds#067.src: This cave here is where much of the mist pools. You can't tell from here, but it's very windy in there!
Burning Bonds#067.dst: 這座洞穴就是霧氣匯聚的地方。從外面看不出來，但裡面的風非常強！
Burning Bonds#067.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#068.src: At its end is an outcrop of rock with some of the sharpest stalagmites you've ever seen formed from those harsh winds.
Burning Bonds#068.dst: 洞穴盡頭有一片岩層，那些強風在上面造出了你這輩子見過最鋒利的石筍。
Burning Bonds#068.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#069.src: You'll need to head in and reach that outcrop. I'll try and call out to you if I see any bursts of wind heading your way, but you'll have to dodge them on your own!
Burning Bonds#069.dst: 你得走進去，抵達那片岩層。如果我看見有陣風朝你過去，我會盡量喊你，但躲還是得靠你自己！
Burning Bonds#069.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#070.src: If you get hit you'll be blown back, but try not to be blown back too far.
Burning Bonds#070.dst: 被吹中的話你會被推回去，盡量別被推得太遠。
Burning Bonds#070.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#071.src: You can walk in once you're ready to start.
Burning Bonds#071.dst: 你準備好開始了就可以走進去。
Burning Bonds#071.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#073.src: I'll meet you back at my campsite.
Burning Bonds#073.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#074.src: Thank you so much again for all the help you've granted me!
Burning Bonds#074.dst: 再次感謝你給我的這一切幫助！
Burning Bonds#074.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#075.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Abramod 營地。

Burning Bonds#077.src: We are going to make the medallion now, are we not?
Burning Bonds#077.dst: 我們現在就來做徽牌，好嗎？
Burning Bonds#077.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#078.src: It looks like I marked out for you the spots on the medallion that have to be cut out.
Burning Bonds#078.dst: 看來徽牌上要切掉的位置，我已經替你標好了。
Burning Bonds#078.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#079.src: All you have to do is cut them. Easy.
Burning Bonds#079.dst: 你只要把它們切下來就行。很簡單。
Burning Bonds#079.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#081.src: Good! I will drag the knife down. And you will push it in to cut!
Burning Bonds#081.dst: 很好！我把刀往下帶，你負責把它壓進去切！
Burning Bonds#081.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#082.src: You're not ready!? Then get ready, quickly! We do not have time to waste.
Burning Bonds#082.dst: 你還沒準備好？！那就快點準備好！我們沒有時間可以浪費。
Burning Bonds#082.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#084.src: Good! Good! Look at how beautiful it is!
Burning Bonds#084.dst: 很好！很好！你看它多麼漂亮！
Burning Bonds#084.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#085.src: The intricacy! The style! With this, I will be able to get into any clan I want!
Burning Bonds#085.dst: 這份細緻！這個樣式！有了它，我想進哪個氏族就能進哪個氏族！
Burning Bonds#085.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#086.src: But... there is a loose end isn't there. Even if I can go anywhere I want... you will always know, won't you?
Burning Bonds#086.dst: 不過……還有個沒收乾淨的尾巴，對吧。就算我能去任何我想去的地方……你永遠都會知道，不是嗎？
Burning Bonds#086.speaker: Abramod

Burning Bonds#087.src: You are a danger that cannot be allowed to persist!
Burning Bonds#087.dst: 你是一個不能容許繼續存在的威脅！
Burning Bonds#087.speaker: Abramod
